table_caption.quote: Crotonyl-CoA-dependent NADH oxidation and ferredoxin reduction catalyzed by purified butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase/Etf complex from C. kluyveri

h2_endpoint.quote: Ferredoxin reduction (measured via H2 formation in the presence of hydrogenase)

temperature_note.quote: The specific activity at 37°C is indicated in parentheses. The NADH oxidation assay and the TTC reduction assay were routinely performed at 25°C, whereas the H2 formation assay was performed at 37°C.

specificity_warning.quote: Both the absolute and relative values of the specific activities varied from preparation to preparation. This was not only because the enzyme complex was very labile but also because there were inherent difficulties with the activity measurements. Some of the reactions started with a considerable lag period, and the rates of the reactions were not always proportional to the amounts of enzyme added.

text_background_not_table.quote: In the absence of ferredoxin and hydrogenase, the purified butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase/Etf complex catalyzed the oxidation of NADH with crotonyl-CoA with a specific activity of only 0.3 to 0.4 U/mg protein.

qualitative_subunit_evidence.quote: During purification the butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase/Etf complex partially dissociated into its components, as shown by the finding that fractions containing mainly the 41-kDa subunit and other fractions containing mainly the 36- or 28-kDa subunit were obtained. In the NADH oxidation assay only the complete complex appeared to be active.

ferredoxin_origin.quote: Ferredoxin from Clostridium pasteurianum (ɛ390 = 30 mM−1 cm−1) (16) was either purified from cell extracts of C. pasteurianum by chromatography on Q-Sepharose, Phenyl-Sepharose, and Superdex 75 (42) or obtained from Sigma-Aldrich Chemie GmbH. Essentially identical results were obtained with both ferredoxins.

table2_conditions_and_endpoint_unit_defi.quote: Assays with activity are indicated by bold type. For NADH oxidation each 1-ml assay mixture incubated at 25°C contained 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 0.1 mM NADH, 0.1 mM crotonyl-CoA, 5 μM FAD, 2 mM DTT, 0.01 mg purified butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase/Etf complex, and, where indicated, 20 μM ferredoxin (Fd), 0.4 U hydrogenase (Hyd) from C. pasteurianum, and/or 1 mM methyl viologen. For TTC reduction each 1-ml assay mixture incubated at 25°C contained 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 0.2 mM NADH, 0.1 mM crotonyl-CoA, 5 μM FAD, 0.4 mM TTC, 2 mM DTT, 0.01 mg purified butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase/Etf complex, and, where indicated, 20 μM ferredoxin. For ferredoxin reduction each 0.5-ml assay mixture incubated at 37°C contained 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 2 mM DTT, 2.5 mM NADH, 1 mM crotonyl-CoA, 10 μM FAD, 0.05 mg purified butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase/Etf complex, and, where indicated, 50 μM ferredoxin, 1.6 U hydrogenase from C. pasteurianum, and/or 1 mM methyl viologen. The reactions were started by addition of crotonyl-CoA. One unit was equivalent to 1 μmol of NADH oxidized per min, 1 μmol of TTC reduced per min, or 1 μmol of H2 formed per min.
